# SELLING THE JUNGLE TO FOREIGNERS?

Arennian engineers! Zharani ports! And who gets the TREASURE under Ibira? THE WATCHMAN has seen this film before — it ends with foreign flags on Kunasaian soil and a plaque with the President's name on it. Edvar Solano demands guarantees that "not one gram leaves this country without a Kunasaian hand on the scale".
